content:
Hannah L: FYI, after tonight's driver push (NVIDIA 536.21) several inference pods in us-west-2-gpu-1 are failing in TF/TRT + FlashAttention codepaths. Getting kernel/JIT errors and plugin load failures.

Raj P: Noted. Which image/toolkit combos are affected? Any specific model runtimes?

Hannah L: Mostly A100 hosts running containers built against CUDA 12.2 toolchain. Node drivers show CUDA 12.1 + driver 536.21. Sample stack: torch 2.2, xformers 0.0.21, TensorRT 8.5.2, custom libflashattn.so.

Maria S: Can you paste the failing log from a pod?

Hannah L: paste: ```RuntimeError: CUDA error: unspecified launch failure
... kernel launch failed: PTX_VERSION_MISMATCH
TensorRT: ERROR: Could not load plugin libflashattn.so: undefined symbol: _ZN6c10...
NVRTC: JIT compilation failed: unsupported PTX version```

Oliver K: That undefined symbol+PTX error smells like PTX JIT/runtime ABI mismatch. 536.x tightened PTX checks and changed some NVRTC behaviour. If the plugin was compiled targeting newer PTX or different sm archs we'll hit this.

Raj P: I inspected hosts: `nvidia-smi` shows A100-SXM4, driver 536.21, CUDA runtime 12.1. Containers were built with CUDA 12.2 SDK. Risky.

Jen T: Can someone run `cuobjdump --list-kernels /opt/conda/.../libflashattn.so` and `ldd` on the TRT plugin on an affected host?

Hannah L: Ran probes: cuobjdump lists ptx for sm_86 and sm_80; the host JIT refuses newer PTX. ldd shows libcuda -> /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 (536.21).

Maria S: Hypothesis: plugin or wheel was built against a newer CUDA toolkit and emits PTX that the current driver rejects. Also many xformers/flash_attn wheels compile kernels at pip install time; mismatched build environments cause latent issues.

OpsBot: driver-rollout status: us-west-2-gpu-1 at 52% complete. Pause/rollback allowed? :warning:

Raj P: Suggested mitigations: 1) set env FLASH_ATTENTION_DISABLED=1 for canary/production pods to avoid plugin load; 2) pause rollout and rollback driver on affected hosts while we triage; 3) rebuild flash_attn/TRT plugins against driver/toolkit matrix and publish compatible wheels.

Maria S: Quick test: flipping FLASH_ATTENTION_DISABLED=1 forces fallback to a slower kernel in xformers; inference succeeds with higher latency but no crash. Canary pool is green after the change.

Oliver K: Ops - please pause the rollout in us-west-2 and queue rollback for the 14 hosts serving production traffic. Also open a cross-team ticket to coordinate rebuilds and add compatibility tests.

DeployBot: Rollout paused by Raj P at 1802461300. Rollback scheduled for 14 hosts.

Jen T: Postmortem starters: collect list of images bundling CUDA toolkits mismatched to driver, add a pre-rollout compatibility CI job that runs `cuda-compat-check.sh` across target drivers (535/536/537) and each instance type (A100/T4). Add host-side sanity check script for PTX/JIT errors.

Hannah L: I'll create the incident doc + RCA stub and attach logs/host lists. We caught this early in canary, so blast radius limited.

Oliver K: Also check NCCL and libnvinfer_plugin versions; some plugin ABIs changed. We should publish a short compatibility matrix for driver/toolkit/trt/flashattn/xformers.

Maria S: Reaching out to upstream flash_attn maintainers about rebuilding wheels for CUDA 12.1/12.2. We'll also test building wheels inside node image that matches host drivers to avoid PTX mismatch at runtime.

Raj P: Action items:
- Pause/rollback driver rollout in us-west-2 (ops)
- Set FLASH_ATTENTION_DISABLED=1 for affected deployments (eng)
- Rebuild and test flash_attn/TRT plugins against driver 536.x (eng-ml)
- Add pre-rollout compatibility CI and host sanity checks (eng-infra)

Hannah L: Incident created 1802461200, last probe 1802463599. I'll post link when doc is live. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

OpsBot: Rollback executed on 14 hosts at 1802463200. Monitoring for residual errors.
